_nota: El inglés de las peleas: nombres, ataques y especiales de los enemigos, sus frases, los diálogos de cada pelea (src/data/batallas/), sus títulos y las charlas de «Hablar». Va por el texto en español (la clave) al inglés. Los ataques de los héroes van en rpg.json. Borrador de Claude (2026-11-05).

textos.El soldado de la Federación lanza un taj: The Federation soldier swings a slash. Standard procedure.
textos.El soldado de la Federación tira una est: The Federation soldier lunges without a word. They never say a word.
textos.…¿Horas extra? No. No nos pagan horas ex: …Overtime? No. They don't pay us overtime.
textos.El procedimiento no contempla esa pregun: The procedure does not cover that question. Processing…
textos.¿De verdad me queda bien? Nadie me lo ha: Does it really look good on me? Nobody ever told me that.
I am not authorized to converse.
textos.El soldado de la Federación se lanza enc: The Federation soldier jumps on top and strikes again and again with the sword. No pause. No expression.
textos.El monstruo alza el brazo y lo baja: una: The monster raises its arm and brings it down: a purple crescent of light crosses the whole hallway.
textos.El monstruo gira sobre sí mismo y suelta: The monster spins in place and lets out three crescents along the floor, one after another.
textos.Los ojos del monstruo se encienden. Por: The monster's eyes light up. For a second, everyone sees what scares them most. Someone can't move.
textos.El monstruo se hunde en su propia sombra: The monster sinks into its own shadow. A vortex stays on the floor. And the vortex moves. Whatever it finds, it lifts into the air.
textos.{quien} le da una cachetada a {objetivo}: {quien} slaps {objetivo} and it lets out a blue shockwave. It sounds like a slammed door.
textos.{quien} le da una cachetada de revés a {: {quien} backhands {objetivo}. With the ring. On purpose.
textos.{quien} cambia de cara de golpe: ojitos,: {quien} switches faces in a flash: puppy eyes, pouty lips and a blown kiss. A heart flies straight at {objetivo}.
textos.A {quien} le arden los ojos. Agarra a {o: {quien}'s eyes burn. She grabs {objetivo} by the clothes and starts: right, left, right, left. On fire. No end in sight.
Nikki, I'm sorry. I went too far. I didn't think.
textos.En serio. Perdón. Ocho años, Nikki, y lo: Seriously. I'm sorry. Eight years, Nikki, and I ruined it in a second.
I have no excuse. Forgive me. Please.
textos.¿Perdón? ¿Ahora sí sabes decir perdón?: Sorry? Now you know how to say sorry?
Keep going. Let's see if I buy it.
textos.Ah, ¿ya se te acabaron las disculpas? Ya: Oh, out of apologies already? I knew it.
textos.Nikki, perdón. Perdón al bar también. Y: Nikki, I'm sorry. Sorry to the bar too. And to that stool. Especially the stool, it didn't do anything.
textos.En serio. Perdón. Perdón a las tres. A l: Seriously. I'm sorry. To all three of you. The one in the middle, most of all. She's the one I said the thing to.
textos.Perdóname. Por favor. Y dile a tu gemela: Forgive me. Please. And tell your twin I'm sorry too. The floating one.
textos.Nikki junta las manos, cierra los ojos y: Nikki puts her hands together, closes her eyes and splits in two. What comes out of her is the same, but made of shadow: weaker, quieter and with the same sour face.
textos.¡Eso es de un anime! Lo vi. Lo vi entero: That's from an anime! I saw it. I watched the whole thing. That's plagiarism, Nikki.
textos.Lo sabía. Lo sabía. Ocho años negándolo: I knew it. I knew it. Eight years denying it and you're a closet otaku.
textos.A {quien} se le prende un aura morada. L: A purple aura lights up around {quien}. She raises her hand and a ball of toxic energy is born in her palm, and it won't stop growing.
textos.¿Me pides perdón y después me pegas? A {: You apologize and then you hit me? A purple aura lights up around {quien}. She raises her hand and a ball of toxic energy is born in her palm, huge, made of eight years.
textos.El capitán apunta sin apuro y suelta una: The captain takes his time aiming and lets out a burst: red beams, one after another, at {objetivo}.
textos.El capitán barre el hangar con el blaste: The captain sweeps the hangar with the blaster: red beams for everyone.
textos.El capitán hinca una rodilla. El blaster: The captain drops to one knee. The blaster hums, heats up, turns white at the tip. He aims at {objetivo}.
textos.…Sigue hablando. Necesito tiempo para ca: …Keep talking. I need time to charge.
I don't negotiate with unregistered entities.
textos.El Rey le corta a {objetivo} sin apuro,: The King cuts {objetivo} without hurry, like someone signing a sentence.
The King swings the sword of the seasons. The edge passes through everyone.
textos.{quien} desenvaina la espada de las esta: {quien} draws the sword of the seasons. Four kingdoms on a single edge, against {objetivo}.
textos.{quien} corta el aire. Del corte se abre: {quien} cuts the air. From the cut opens a rift that leads nowhere.
textos.El bicho le muerde el tobillo a {objetiv: The bug bites {objetivo}'s ankle. It clicks, like an error.
textos.Una nube de bichos chicos le pasa por en: A cloud of tiny bugs runs over everyone.
textos.El bicho muerde un cable y {objetivo} qu: The bug bites a cable and {objetivo} goes stiff from the shock.
textos.El bodeguero le da un palazo a {objetivo: The storekeeper smacks {objetivo} with a shovel. Methodically.
textos.Le tira un saco de harina a {objetivo},: Throws a sack of flour at {objetivo}, who can't see a thing.
textos.El cocinero corta a {objetivo} como si f: The cook chops {objetivo} like an onion.
Throws the whole pot at everyone.
textos.El cocinero le tira un puñado de sal a {: The cook throws a fistful of salt in {objetivo}'s eyes. Can't see a thing.
textos.El herrero le da un martillazo a {objeti: The blacksmith hits {objetivo} with a hammer. Sounds like an anvil.
A shower of sparks falls on everyone.
textos.El escriba tacha a {objetivo} de la pági: The scribe crosses {objetivo} off the page.
textos.El escriba le corrige el nombre a {objet: The scribe corrects {objetivo}'s name. Now they don't know who they are.
textos.El celador le pega a {objetivo} con el m: The jailer hits {objetivo} with the bunch of keys.
textos.Le pone un grillete a {objetivo}, que no: Puts a shackle on {objetivo}, who can't move.
textos.El caballero le corta a {objetivo} con l: The knight cuts {objetivo} with the precision of a primary key.
textos.Los caballeros cargan en formación contr: The knights charge in formation against everyone.
textos.La reina le clava el aguijón a {objetivo: The queen drives her stinger into {objetivo}.
textos.Una nube de crías sale de debajo de la r: A cloud of hatchlings comes out from under the queen.
textos.La reina zumba tan fuerte que a {objetiv: The queen buzzes so loud that {objetivo} forgets where they are.
textos.La reina abre las alas. Todo el nido sal: The queen spreads her wings. The whole nest comes out at once, and there's nowhere to hide.
textos.La reina se agacha sobre el nido. Un hue: The queen crouches over the nest. An egg cracks and out comes a hatchling, small, fast and just as ill-intentioned.
textos.Está generando bugs nuevos mientras arre: She's generating new bugs while we fix the old ones. It's my job, but with legs.
textos.El jefe de bodega le pega a {objetivo} c: The head storekeeper hits {objetivo} with the ledger. Hardcover.
textos.El jefe de bodega le pide a {objetivo} l: The head storekeeper asks {objetivo} for receipts for everything. {objetivo} doesn't even know their own name anymore.
textos.El jefe de bodega tira cajas a todos. Cu: The head storekeeper throws crates at everyone. Counts each one out loud.
textos.El jefe de bodega cierra el libro de un: The head storekeeper slams the ledger shut. «Shortage corrected.» Aims at {objetivo}.
textos.El sargento grita «¡fuego!» y le cae tod: The sergeant yells «fire!» and everything lands on {objetivo}.
textos.El sargento le grita «¡firmes!» a {objet: The sergeant yells «attention!» at {objetivo}, who freezes without meaning to.
textos.El sargento se arranca medallas y las ti: The sergeant rips off his medals and throws them like knives at everyone.
textos.El sargento baja la cabeza y carga. Tres: The sergeant lowers his head and charges. Three times. At {objetivo}.
textos.El chef le da con el cucharón de hierro: The chef hits {objetivo} with the iron ladle.
textos.El chef reparte el plato del día a todos: The chef serves everyone the dish of the day. Boiling.
textos.El chef da vuelta todas las ollas a la v: The chef flips every pot at once. Everyone eats, like it or not.
textos.{quien} destapa una olla. Lo de adentro: {quien} lifts a lid. What's inside bubbles green and stares back at them. He serves everyone, his helpers included.
textos.El maestro herrero le da a {objetivo} co: The master blacksmith hits {objetivo} with the red-hot hammer.
textos.El maestro herrero golpea el yunque y la: The master blacksmith strikes the anvil and the sparks rain down on everyone.
textos.El maestro herrero levanta el yunque ent: The master blacksmith lifts the whole anvil over his head. He throws it at {objetivo}.
textos.El alcaide le pega a {objetivo} con el l: The warden hits {objetivo} with the keyring of the whole prison.
textos.El alcaide da vuelta todas las llaves a: The warden turns every key at once. The bars slam into everyone.
textos.El alcaide suelta la cadena del cinturón: The warden unhooks the chain from his belt and swings it. Four loops around {objetivo}.
textos.El intendente le tira a {objetivo} lo pr: The quartermaster throws the first thing he finds on the shelf at {objetivo}.
textos.El intendente barre a todos con una lanz: The quartermaster sweeps everyone with a long spear.
textos.El intendente patea el armero. Espadas,: The quartermaster kicks the weapon rack. Swords, axes and spears rain down on everyone.
textos.El comandante le corta a {objetivo} con: The commander cuts {objetivo} with the precision of a primary key.
textos.El comandante da una orden y la guardia: The commander gives an order and the guard strikes everyone in formation.
textos.El comandante le grita el número de {obj: The commander shouts {objetivo}'s number. {objetivo} freezes, as if they were in the table.
textos.El comandante baja la visera. «Cada fila: The commander lowers his visor. «Every row, a sentence.» The sword falls twice on everyone.
textos.El guardia del Verano clava la lanza en: The Summer guard drives his spear into {objetivo}. Shark teeth show no mercy.
textos.El guardia golpea el suelo y una ola de: The guard strikes the ground and a wave of heat washes over everyone.
textos.El guardia del Otoño le da con el escudo: The Autumn guard hits {objetivo} with his round shield.
textos.El guardia lanza un grito de cuervo y {o: The guard lets out a raven's cry and {objetivo} loses their train of thought.
textos.El guardia del Invierno parte el aire, y: The Winter guard splits the air, and {objetivo}, with his axe.
textos.La barba del guardia suelta escarcha y {: The guard's beard sheds frost and {objetivo} goes stiff with cold.
textos.Oigan, ¿a ustedes les pagan horas extra: Hey, do you guys get paid overtime for this?
If you let me go, I'll build you a website. Responsive.
textos.¿Esa máscara es del uniforme o es person: Is that mask part of the uniform or personal? It suits you, eh.
textos.Yo también odio mi trabajo. Podríamos no: I hate my job too. We could not do it together.
textos.Oigan, ¿a ustedes les pagan horas extra: Hey, do you guys get paid overtime for… why is the floor on the ceiling?
If you let me go, I'll build you a website. Responsive. Like my knees. Which no longer respond.
textos.Yo también odio mi trabajo. ¿Cuál era mi: I hate my job too. What was my job? Do you know? Do you pay me?
Put that down before I put you down.
textos.Tienes la postura de alguien que perdió: You've got the stance of someone who's lost a lot of fights.
textos.¿Te mandaron solo? Qué triste. Para ti,: They sent you alone? How sad. For you, I mean.
textos.{quien} necesita recuperarse de su dolor: {quien} needs to recover from the pain.
textos.Baja eso antes de que te lo… ¿siempre fu: Put that down before I put you… were there always three of you? How rude.
textos.Tienes la postura de alguien que… qué li: You've got the stance of someone who… your helmet shines so pretty. Don't look at me like that. You, the one in the middle.
textos.¿Te mandaron solo? ¿Y por qué son cuatro: They sent you alone? Then why are there four of you? Answer one at a time.
textos.¿Sabes cuánto cuesta esa armadura? Yo sí: Do you know how much that armor costs? I do. And I feel sorry for you.
textos.Arrodíllate ante una sacerdotisa. Por fa: Kneel before a priestess. Please. It's free.
textos.Alarma del Bastión: activa. Entidades ho: Bastion alarm: active. Hostile entities en route.
textos.Tú pegas y yo disparo. Y nada de mirarme: You hit, I shoot. And no looking at my ankle.
textos.El soldado pide refuerzos por radio ante: The soldier radios for backup before he falls. Another one arrives, identical.
textos.(Ese ruido. Un módem conectándose. Lo co: (That noise. A modem connecting. I know it from work.)
textos.Es el de antes. El de la tinta. ¡No deje: It's the one from before. The ink one. Don't let it touch you!
textos.El monstruo se hunde en su sombra. El vó: The monster sinks into its shadow. The vortex pulls back until it's lost at the end of the hallway. It didn't leave: it just stopped being in sight.
Hostile entity: out of visual range.
textos.(No se fue. Solo dejó de estar a la vist: (It didn't leave. It just stopped being in sight. I know the difference.)
textos.¿Me vas a dejar peleando sola? Qué cabal: You're leaving me to fight alone? What a gentleman. What a coward.
You're not going anywhere. Get back here.
They escape down a side hallway.
Give me a second… My ankle.
textos.¿Jair? ¡Jair! Genial. Ahora tengo que ha: Jair? Jair! Great. Now I have to do everything myself, as always.
textos.{objetivo} se queda pensando. Pierde su: {objetivo} stops to think. Loses their next attack.
The {objetivo} drops something: {objeto}. Into the backpack.
textos.Algo cae del techo y rebota en el piso:: Something falls from the ceiling and bounces on the floor: {objeto}. Nobody asks where from. Into the backpack.
textos.[Relleno] El campamento. TODO(canon): có: [Filler] The camp. TODO(canon): how this fight starts.
textos.[Relleno] Llega el capitán. TODO(canon):: [Filler] The captain arrives. TODO(canon): who the boss of this fight is.
textos.[Relleno] Ganaron. TODO(canon): cómo sig: [Filler] You won. TODO(canon): what comes next.
textos.[Relleno] Perdieron. TODO(canon): el bad: [Filler] You lost. TODO(canon): this fight's bad end.
textos.[Relleno] El almacén del molino. TODO(ca: [Filler] The mill storehouse. TODO(canon): how this fight starts.
textos.[Relleno] Cami armored. TODO(canon): cóm: [Filler] Armored Cami. TODO(canon): how this fight starts.
textos.[Relleno] La muralla. TODO(canon): cómo: [Filler] The wall. TODO(canon): how this fight starts.
textos.> El capitán del arsenal defiende la esp: > The arsenal captain defends the sword.
> There's no way out. Only up.
textos.> El usuario cayó. Que alguien lo levant: > The user is down. Someone pick him up.
> The scribes turn back into ink.
> The captain of the guard arrives.
> The bugs hide in the water.
textos.> El capitán de los cuarteles entra a la: > The barracks captain joins the fight.
> The barracks are out of medals.
> The knights step out of the paintings.
textos.> Comandante de la guardia real entra a: > Commander of the Royal Guard joins the fight.
> The way to the throne, clear.
textos.> Nadie sale de esta torre. Salvo ustede: > Nobody leaves this tower. Except you.
> The royal guard protects its King.
> The Evil King rises from the throne.
> The King falls to his knees.
> The ink goes back to the floor.
textos.Demo de batalla: Jair, Cami y Rikka cont: Battle demo: Jair, Cami and Rikka against the Bastion horde. Here you can run away.
textos.Alarma del hangar: activa. Acceso no aut: Hangar alarm: active. Unauthorized access to a decorative resource.
textos.Te dije que no tocaras nada. …No te lo d: I told you not to touch anything. …I didn't tell you. But it was obvious.
textos.Otro soldado entra por la puerta del fon: Another soldier comes in through the back door. Identical. Always identical.
textos.Pasos más pesados. Una armadura gris con: Heavier footsteps. Gray armor with copper edges and a red V-shaped visor.
textos.Guerrera. Te dimos por muerta. Y traes c: Warrior. We had you for dead. And you brought company.
textos.Me acuerdo de ti. Eras el capitán que gr: I remember you. You were the captain who yelled a lot.
textos.El capitán retrocede entre las naves, si: The captain backs off between the ships, still aiming. The blaster keeps glowing.
textos.(Retrocede. No se va. Hay una diferencia: (He's backing off. He's not leaving. There's a difference, and I know it.)
textos.Entidad no registrada. Procedimiento: ar: Unregistered entity. Procedure: archive. Along with the warrior.
textos.¿Huir? ¿Por dónde? Encendiste el hangar: Run? Where to? You lit up the whole hangar.
textos.¿Jair? ¡Jair! ¿Me vas a dejar sola con e: Jair? Jair! You're leaving me alone with the captain? Typical.
You want a fight? I'll give you a fight.
textos.Ocho años sacando a Jair de los bares, c: Eight years dragging Jair out of bars, carrying him to the taxi and putting up with his drama also gives you experience.
Nobody comes to help. It's a bar.
textos.Te aprovechaste de mí. Estaba borracha y: You took advantage of me. I was drunk and you took advantage of me.
textos.Y encima me levantaste la mano. Tú. Just: And on top of that you raised your hand at me. You. Of all people.
textos.Nikki agarra su bolso y se va del bar ll: Nikki grabs her bag and leaves the bar crying. She doesn't say goodbye. This time it does count as leaving.
You won. It doesn't feel like winning.
textos.Nikki se queda con la mano en el aire. L: Nikki stays with her hand in the air. It's shaking. Then her eyes fill up.
Where do you think you're going? Sit down.
You don't run away from this.
Jair tries to leave. He can't.
Nobody moves. Not even the bartender.
textos.Nikki duda. Un segundo. Le alcanza para: Nikki hesitates. One second. It's enough not to hit.
textos.{quien} esquiva la cachetada. Puro insti: {quien} dodges the slap. Pure survival instinct.
textos.En el piso, entre los vidrios, hay algo: On the floor, between the broken glass, there's something sticky: {objeto}. Who knows since when. Into the backpack.
textos.Nikki baja la mano. Respira. Ya no tiene: Nikki lowers her hand. Breathes. She doesn't feel like hitting him anymore. She feels like something else: a beer.
textos.Cami, somos del mismo equipo. ¿Te acuerd: Cami, we're on the same team. Remember? I carried you.
textos.¿Podemos hablarlo como adultos? Tú bajas: Can we talk about this like adults? You lower the weapon and I stop shaking.
textos.…Me cargaste tres pasillos y te quejaste: …You carried me down three hallways and complained in all three. But fine. One turn.
textos.Hablas mucho para alguien que pelea tan: You talk a lot for someone who fights so little.
textos.Rikka, no tenemos que hacer esto. Vamos: Rikka, we don't have to do this. Let's go get a drink. My treat.
textos.Te queda muy bien la espada. Digo… por f: The sword looks great on you. I mean… please, put it down.
textos.¿Invitas tú? ¿De verdad? …Bueno. Pero qu: Your treat? Really? …Fine. But make it cheap.
textos.Una sacerdotisa no se compra con un trag: A priestess can't be bought with a drink. …How many drinks?
textos.No me mires así. No funciona. Casi no fu: Don't look at me like that. It doesn't work. It almost doesn't work.
textos.Oye… yo. ¿Esto cuenta como terapia?: Hey… me. Does this count as therapy?
textos.Si te pego, ¿me duele a mí?: If I hit you, does it hurt me?
Don't listen to me. I never listen to myself.
textos.Lindo… ¿eso es petróleo o es tu personal: Nice… is that oil or is it your personality?
If you stay still, I promise not to scream.
textos.La sombra ladea la cabeza. Algo de eso l: The shadow tilts its head. Something about that amused it. Or made it hungry.
The shadow smiles with too many teeth.
Sit down, Jair. This isn't for you.
Against me? Really? Not even as a joke.
textos.…Sí, sí. Me siento. Perdón. Ya me siento: …Yes, yes. I'm sitting. Sorry. Sitting down now.
textos.No. Esta vez no me escondo. …Bueno, casi: No. This time I'm not hiding. …Well, almost.
textos.Oye, la del bar. ¿Viniste a pelear o a l: Hey, bar girl. Did you come to fight or to cry?
textos.Te queda bien el negro. Combina con tu f: Black suits you. It matches your future.
textos.¿Me estás hablando a mí, muñeca del espa: Are you talking to me, space doll? …Say it again, I didn't hear you.
textos.Ni me hables. Me arruinas el maquillaje: Don't even talk to me. You ruin my makeup just by existing.
Look, blondie: I don't know you and I already hate you.
textos.Princesa, apártate. Te vas a ensuciar el: Princess, step aside. You'll get your kimono dirty.
textos.¿Quieres pelear o quieres que alguien te: Do you want to fight or do you want someone to look at you?
At least someone looks at me.
textos.No soy princesa. Soy sacerdotisa. Hay un: I'm not a princess. I'm a priestess. There's a difference in rank.
Good. Finally someone at my level.
textos.Si te rindes ahora, no le cuento a nadie: If you give up now, I won't tell anyone.
Don't look at me like that. Nobody looks at me like that.
Come here. I'll wipe that smile off.
textos.Pareces más grande de lo que eres. Te en: You look bigger than you are. I get it.
The shadow takes a step back. One.
The shadow laughs. No mouth, but it laughs.
textos.Jair… ¿de verdad vas a pegarme? ¿A mí?: Jair… are you really going to hit me? Me?
textos.Si me ganas, ¿después me invitas a comer: If you beat me, will you buy me dinner after? So it's not for nothing.
textos.No. No, claro que no. ¿Qué hago con las: No. No, of course not. What do I do with my hands?
textos.Rikka, es una pelea de prueba. No te pon: Rikka, it's a practice fight. Don't get like that.
textos.Cami, no tienes que ser tan agresiva. Re: Cami, you don't have to be so aggressive. Breathe. Like this.
textos.Te presto mi espada si me dejas ganar. E: I'll lend you my sword if you let me win. It's ancient. It's worth a lot. I think.
Keep your sword. And your pity.
textos.Nikki, ¿te acuerdas de esa canción de la: Nikki, remember that Blueberries song? Let's not fight with that song stuck in our heads.
textos.Después de esto te invito… no. Invitas t: After this I'll treat you to… no. You're treating. I don't have any money.
textos.…Ay, no. Me la pusiste en la cabeza. Gra: …Oh, no. Now it's stuck in my head. Thanks a lot.
textos.Me caes bien, Rikka. Igual te voy a pega: I like you, Rikka. I'm still going to hit you.
textos.¿Esa soy yo? ¿Así me veo cuando me enojo: Is that me? Is that what I look like when I'm angry?
textos.Tenemos el mismo kimono. Una de las dos: We have the same kimono. One of us is changing.
textos.Espíritu impuro: en nombre de la Primave: Impure spirit: in the name of Spring, withdraw. Please.
textos.No te tengo miedo. Un poco. Pero no much: I'm not afraid of you. A little. But not much.
textos.La sombra se encoge. Parece que la Prima: The shadow shrinks. Looks like Spring is still scary.
textos.La sombra no conoce la Primavera. Ni le: The shadow doesn't know Spring. Doesn't care either.
textos.Jair, mírame. ¿Te parece que estoy para: Jair, look at me. Do I look like I'm in the mood to talk?
textos.Dale. Pídeme perdón. Me encanta cuando n: Go ahead. Say sorry. I love it when you don't know what to say.
textos.…Perdón. Por lo que sea. Por todo, si qu: …Sorry. For whatever. For everything, if you want.
textos.Tú. La del traje de látex. Ven, que te a: You. The one in the latex suit. Come here, I'll fix your face for free.
textos.¿Ya conseguiste trabajo o sigues viviend: Did you get a job yet or are you still living off drama?
textos.Hablas mucho para alguien que mide un me: You talk a lot for someone who's five feet tall.
I'm not even answering you. You know why.
textos.Rikka, linda, hazte a un lado. No es con: Rikka, sweetie, step aside. This isn't about you.
textos.Si me ganas te pago un trago. Si pierdes: If you beat me I'll buy you a drink. If you lose, too. I want to drink anyway.
textos.¿Un trago? ¿Lo pagas tú? …Entonces sí, m: A drink? You're paying? …Then yes, I'll step aside.
textos.Lo siento, Nikki. Tengo que pelear. Pero: Sorry, Nikki. I have to fight. But after, sure.
textos.Mírate. Estás hecha un desastre. Me enca: Look at you. You're a mess. I love it.
…Fine. Let's go get a beer and drop it.
textos.¿Tienes cara debajo de eso o es todo cas: Do you have a face under that or is it all helmet?
textos.Uy, qué feo. Pareces mi ex a las tres de: Ew, so ugly. You look like my ex at three in the morning.
If you touch me, I'll throw my beer on you.
The shadow looks at itself. Hesitates.
The shadow doesn't care about your ex.
textos.El claro de las cuatro estaciones: The clearing of the four seasons
textos.Entidad hostil: la de la tinta. Ahora co: Hostile entity: the ink one. Now with autumn stones on top.
textos.¡Te dije lo del hielo! …Bueno. Desde aqu: I told you about the ice! …Fine. I can shoot from here too.
textos.Las rocas se le caen a pedazos. El monst: The rocks fall off it in chunks. The monster backs toward the stream, wounded.
textos.(Le pegué a un monstruo de piedra. Con m: (I punched a stone monster. With office-worker hands. Nobody's going to believe me.)
textos.¿Ahora quieres correr? Tarde. Era antes,: Now you want to run? Too late. That was before, across the ice.
textos.¡Es el de la tinta! Y ahora con piedras: It's the ink one! And now with rocks on top. Hit it where there aren't any!
There's nowhere to run. Only the ice.
textos.El cabo lanza un tajo a {objetivo}. Lo a: The corporal swings a slash at {objetivo}. He learned it in a two-day course.
textos.El cabo tira una estocada a {objetivo},: The corporal lunges at {objetivo}, more eager than skilled.
textos.El cabo se lanza sobre {objetivo} y golp: The corporal jumps on {objetivo} and strikes nonstop. No pause. Little expression.
textos.Entidad hostil: un soldado de la Federac: Hostile entity: one Federation soldier. Just one.
textos.Uno solo. Perfecto para que aprendas. Te: Just one. Perfect for you to learn. I tell you what to do and you do it, okay?
textos.«Atacar»: le pegas. Para eso tienes mano: «Attack»: you hit him. That's what hands are for. Pick who and that's it.
textos.«Esquivar»: si ves venir algo grande, te: «Dodge»: if you see something big coming, you duck. Sometimes it works, sometimes it doesn't.
textos.«Objetos»: te pasé un agua de la Resiste: «Items»: I passed you a Resistance water, it's in your bag. If it hurts, drink it.
textos.Antes de caer, el soldado alcanza a apre: Before he falls, the soldier manages to press his radio. Another one arrives.
textos.Llamó a su cabo. Claro que llamó a su ca: He called his corporal. Of course he called his corporal.
textos.Mira la barra debajo de tu nombre. Se ll: Look at the bar under your name. It fills up as you fight. When it glows, your special shows up under «Attack». Use it.
textos.Y no te preocupes por mí: yo disparo un: And don't worry about me: I shoot every other turn. It's the ankle, not my aim.
That's it. Ducking is fighting too.
textos.El cabo retrocede por el pasillo, apreta: The corporal backs down the hallway, clutching his radio. He's not going anywhere alone: he's going to get everyone.
Not bad. For an office worker.
textos.Usuario: incapacitado en el tutorial. Pa: User: incapacitated in the tutorial. Game: not saved.
It's one. One. We're not running from one.
textos.El monstruo cierra el puño de piedra, se: The monster clenches its stone fist, purple flames catch on it, and it brings it down on {objetivo}. Snow flies.
textos.El monstruo levanta el brazo. Del suelo: The monster raises its arm. Little rock mountains burst from the ground, one after another, until they reach everyone.
textos.El cielo se pone morado. Entre las nubes: The sky turns purple. Meteors start falling through the clouds, more and more of them, bursting purple on everyone.
textos.El monstruo se agacha, se encoge y se vu: The monster crouches, curls up and turns into a stone ball covered in spikes. Hitting it now is going to hurt.
textos.{quien} levanta el puño de la armadura y: {quien} raises her armored fist and fires. The blaster is more into it than she is.
textos.A {quien} se le cierra el casco sobre la: The helmet snaps shut over {quien}'s face. The visor lights up. Two cannons come out of her shoulders.
textos.[Prueba] Cami armored contra los soldado: [Test] Armored Cami against the mill soldiers. Berserk is always ready: afterwards, Cami rests one turn.
